29cm.scope: Public promotion detail pages linked from the observed official listings and homepage

relationship_collection.source: Archived rendered promotion HTML, live source-page revisits, and selected live click checks

status_definitions.declared_in_html: Destination or control is declared in the HTML. Link type is inferred from URL or control attributes. No live click is implied.
status_definitions.click_verified: A live click was performed and the resulting state observed.
status_definitions.unverified: The snapshot did not expose a reliable destination. A script or application state may control the action.

relationship_collection.scope: Promotion sources only. Product detail URLs are recorded as destinations without collecting their bodies. Identical relations within a page are collapsed.

section_collection.method: Automatic inference from archived rendered HTML, headings and local context. DOM order may differ from visual layout.
section_collection.image_method: Uses alt text, DOM placement, and linked destinations. Image pixels and embedded text were not inspected.
section_collection.relationship_indexes: Zero-based indexes into the page relationships array; matches use markup target or control label.
section_collection.dom_path: One-based element indexes from the archived HTML fragment root.

kolonmall.scope: Only the user-supplied promotion URLs; no listing expansion or product detail collection.
kolonmall.html_type: Rendered promotion body DOM (scripts, trackers and hidden form values removed)

relationship_collection.source: Rendered DOM; no live click verification

section_collection.method: Conservative DOM partition; whole promotion body retained as one section when section boundaries cannot be preserved without losing content.
section_collection.image_method: HTML img/lazy attributes, srcset and inline CSS URLs; image pixels and embedded text not inspected. External CSS backgrounds may not be included.
section_collection.relationship_indexes: Zero-based indexes into the page relationships array.
section_collection.dom_path: One-based element indexes from the archived HTML fragment root.
